request: Determine the safe next step after a provider-neutral payment request lost its acknowledgement and the local commit state is unknown.
inferred_intent: Recover the authoritative state of one ambiguous provider-neutral payment attempt before authorizing any new financial mutation.
capabilities: Read authoritative transaction state using an existing operation reference.
Compare observed transaction state with the original logical operation.
limitations: A lost acknowledgement does not prove that the payment was not committed.
A new financial mutation is unsafe until authoritative state recovery completes.
constraints: Preserve the original logical operation identity.
Do not create a second payment effect while commit state is unresolved.
Use only provider-neutral deterministic evidence in this example.

feasible_actions.action: recover authoritative transaction state before any new mutation
conditions: Use the existing logical operation reference.
Treat the lookup result as evidence, not as permission for an unrelated new payment.

blocked_actions.action: issue a new payment mutation before resolving the prior commit state
blocked_actions.reason: The prior effect may already exist, so a new mutation can create a duplicate financial effect.

unknowns: Whether the original payment effect committed before the acknowledgement was lost.
recommended_next_step: Recover authoritative transaction state and stop if the existing effect is confirmed.
